categories.main_business_segments: Shouyao Holdings is primarily engaged in innovative drug research and development, focusing on small molecule anti-tumor drugs. The company develops novel targeted therapies for various cancers including non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), thyroid cancer, pancreatic cancer, and hematologic malignancies. It also undertakes cooperative drug development projects with major pharmaceutical companies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as AI-driven drug design, target biology, pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, toxicology, and clinical research platforms. It has developed proprietary platforms for small molecule design, drug screening, ADMET prediction, synthesis process development, formulation research, quality control, and clinical trial management. Production is currently outsourced to contract manufacturing organizations (CMO/CDMO) under the Marketing Authorization Holder (MAH) model.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are pharmaceutical companies engaged in cooperative drug development and clinical research institutions. The end markets are domestic Chinese hospitals and oncology treatment centers, focusing on patients with cancers driven by specific genetic mutations such as ALK, RET, KRAS (G12C), and others. The company targets unmet medical needs in oncology and aims to improve patient survival and quality of life.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with clinical trials conducted across nearly 100 domestic centers. It is headquartered in Beijing and plans to expand commercial operations in major Chinese cities. Internationally, it participates in global academic exchanges and multi-center clinical trials, enhancing its global presence in oncology drug development.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shouyao Holdings operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug discovery, preclinical research, clinical trials, and regulatory submissions. It does not currently engage in large-scale commercial manufacturing or direct sales but plans to build a sales team and collaborate with contract sales organizations for market penetration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on developing first-in-class and best-in-class small molecule targeted therapies for oncology, with a pipeline covering multiple generations of ALK inhibitors, selective RET inhibitors, KRAS (G12C) inhibitors, FGFR4 inhibitors, and WEE1 inhibitors. It emphasizes AI-enabled drug design, multi-target inhibition strategies, and combination therapies to overcome resistance. The company is also expanding into large molecule drug platforms and plans to enhance its clinical and manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Currently, revenue is generated mainly from milestone payments and cooperative research and development service fees with pharmaceutical partners. The company has no commercial drug sales revenue yet as its proprietary drugs are in clinical or regulatory review stages. Future revenue is expected from product sales, licensing, and royalties upon drug commercialization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shouyao Holdings is positioned as a leading innovative drug developer in China’s oncology sector, particularly noted for having the first fully domestic third-generation ALK inhibitor in clinical trials. It competes with both domestic and international pharmaceutical companies developing ALK, RET, and KRAS inhibitors. The company’s broad and differentiated pipeline and strong R&D capabilities provide competitive advantages in the evolving targeted therapy market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024 year-end, the company had total assets of approximately RMB 922 million and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 810 million. It reported a net loss of RMB 212 million in 2024, reflecting ongoing heavy R&D investment. R&D expenses increased by 4.95% year-over-year to RMB 213 million, representing over 5,395% of revenue due to limited current sales. The company maintains a strong cash position with RMB 868 million in cash and financial assets, supporting continued clinical development and near-term commercialization efforts.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shouyao Holdings emphasizes developing innovative, highly selective, and efficacious targeted therapies addressing unmet clinical needs in oncology. Its products demonstrate competitive efficacy and safety profiles, with some candidates showing best-in-class potential. The company’s integrated AI-driven drug discovery and full-chain R&D platform enable rapid development and differentiation. It aims to provide affordable, accessible first-in-class and best-in-class drugs to Chinese patients, reducing dependence on imported therapies.
